method: OpenCV Canny + HoughLinesP on white-matted source; hand-selected long structural edge candidates
interpretation: Both sampled edge slopes differ from the iso2x_v1 ±0.5 target; the long shelf edge deviates by about 35 source px at its far endpoint. The second edge is short and therefore approximate. This is a focused rejection signal, not a complete calibrated world-control-point solution.
pass_tolerance: Project spec requires ±1 source px per XY axis endpoint; candidate fails by a wide margin on the long axis.
